data.explanation: This is a normal invoice for electrical work carried out in your home on 17 March 2026: a new sub-distribution board with residual-current and circuit breakers, the electrician's labour and a call-out fee. Check that the work matches what was done, then transfer €1,214.99 to the bank account shown, using the invoice number as reference, by the deadline shown. Labour costs for work in your home may be deductible in your tax return, so keep the invoice and proof of bank transfer.
